title: Communication Resources | Alpha-gal Syndrome | CDC
content: Communication Resources Mar. 27, 2026 At a glance CDC has developed tools to help people better understand alpha-gal syndrome. Materials include a fact sheet for healthcare providers, a brochure for hunters, photos of lone star ticks, and graphics. Healthcare provider fact sheet Support People With Alpha-gal Syndrome Alpha-gal syndrome fact sheet for healthcare providers who want to learn more about the disease. Mar 23, 2026 Download Download Brochure Brochure: What Hunters Should Know About AGS A printable brochure offers hunters information on alpha-gal syndrome and how to prevent it.
